scope: Completed source change classification for the retained repaired Windows reference and the qualified bed29 production source. This is not a performance result.

reference.reason: The retained common rebuild failed G28. The failed evidence remains preserved; source lineage alone does not qualify a comparator.

coverage.note: The inventory includes inactive and test items. Counts are coverage denominators, not executed function counts or a proof of semantic equivalence. Overlapping groups are intentional.

findings: Both versions already use atomic Job assignment. The current implementation adds suspended child admission, including owner and deadline checks before resume.
Current cleanup retains verified member handles before termination and uses a shared absolute cleanup budget with sticky failure handling. These qualified repairs are protected requirements.
The one-shot CLI console attachment device probes match. Returning-library handle custody, console cleanup fallback and owner verification differ.
Normal manual Full dispatch uses AskingDecisions. With no enclosing extension channel, it does not open a pipe or perform optional server I/O; it still reads and caches the environment lookup.
Entry and argument handling, executable resolution, extension enrollment, other roles, build resources and packaging differ and are classified separately.
Old and current native timing markers have different child-start boundaries. Historical marker intervals are not interchangeable.
The canonical repository starts at an import root without the old integration ancestry. Endpoint differences do not identify the historical commit where a slowdown entered.
limits: The classified groups are not item-by-item implementation equivalence, exhaustive SDK or configuration behavior, native loader reachability, or a latency explanation.
No retained timing compares the exact feature-free bed29 executable with an eligible repaired reference. Wake-speed acceptance remains unproven.
No benchmark opportunity was restarted. The incomplete A013 attempt remains failed and cannot be pooled, rescored or replaced.
Source ledgers and original review receipts are retained privately; this sanitized public summary does not replace a reproducible final benchmark package.
